what: Tractor Supply is the largest rural lifestyle retailer in the United States. Its stores sell animal feed, fencing, tools, workwear, trailers and equipment to people who live on acreage, keep livestock or own horses.
customers: Recreational farmers, ranchers, horse owners, pet owners and rural homeowners across the United States.
money: feed, pet food and animal health products
tools, trailers, truck accessories and equipment
Seasonal, gift and toy, and apparel
moat: Stores in rural markets too small for a big-box competitor to enter profitably, selling heavy, bulky goods that are awkward and expensive to ship.
risks: Revenue grew only about 4% last year
Big-ticket items such as trailers and equipment are deferred when consumers are cautious
Analyst targets imply the shares are above fair value
opportunities: Return on invested capital of 14% with a dividend yield around 2.5%
Animal feed and consumables repeat regardless of the economy
Acquiring the Allivet pet pharmacy extends it into prescription pet medicine
watch: Comparable store sales and the split between consumables and big-ticket items.
